text: This staff report is a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District was directed to conduct a comprehensive review of traffic and pedestrian safety on Soudan Avenue, between Yonge Street and Bayview Avenue. The proposed recommendations for safety improvements include: a plan to coordinate construction staging activity for all developments; a plan to improve pedestrian crossing locations through the use of curb depressions and pavement markings; a plan to install advance 'Playground Ahead' and additional '30 km/h' speed limit signs; a review of all traffic regulations; and a plan to work with the Toronto Police Services on enhancing enforcement of excessive driver speeds, running stop signs and travelling the wrong way…
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its July 4, 2018 meeting.
